properties.displayName: AI-SOC Brute Force - Multiple Failed Sign-ins (T1110)
properties.description: Synthetic-demo brute-force detection over the AISOCSigninLogs custom table: >= 5 failed sign-ins from the same IP and user within the window (MITRE T1110 - Credential Access).
properties.query:
AISOCSigninLogs_CL
| where ResultType !in ("0", "50125", "50140")
| summarize FailCount = count(), FirstFail = min(TimeGenerated), LastFail = max(TimeGenerated) by IPAddress, UserPrincipalName_s
| where FailCount >= 5
| project UserPrincipalName = UserPrincipalName_s, IPAddress, FailCount, FirstFail, LastFail
| extend MITRE_Tactic = "Credential Access", MITRE_Technique = "T1110"
